what: A photo cell cut by a petal mask (a five-petal cluster) plays once when 75% of the plate reaches the bottom of the screen. The mask grows from size 0 to the plate size while the plate turns from -90° and the photo inside turns from 90° the opposite way, both ending upright (2s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). The photo stays in place and only the petals spin as it blooms.

options.--fx-mask: Mask image (via style), default is a five-petal blob
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Duration and curve (via style), default 2s · cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.--fx-turn: Starting angle for the panel rotation, default -90deg (reversed for photos)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (If present) Photo inside the panel — counter-rotates against the panel so it stays upright as it blooms
